newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-FORMER SCOTLAND CAPTAIN GEORGE YOUNG DIES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FORMER SCOTLAND CAPTAIN GEORGE YOUNG DIES.

text.p: George Young, who captained Scotland a record 48 times, has died. He was 74.
The Glasgow Rangers defender was capped 53 times in the 1940s and 1950s.

Paying tribute to Young on Saturday, Jim Farry, chief executive of the Scottish F.A., said: "George was a big man in every sense of the word, not only in his physical stature but also in his leadership qualities on the field."
